ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; inform rider that cancellations after the 3-minute matching window are chargeable (Ryde has no driver-late/ETA waiver rule) and that a RydeHELP fee-waiver request is the discretionary remedy.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider asserts the fee should be waived because the driver was still far away after 3 minutes. Under NS-4 an instant-booking rider cancellation after 3 minutes of matching is chargeable; Ryde publishes no free-cancellation right for a driver running late (NS-8 is informational and non-citable, and Ryde has no ETA field). Cancellation occurred at 3 min 20 s (21:30:00 → 21:33:20), so the $6.61 fee stands.

No driver-side no-show basis exists: driver_pressed_here_at is null, no waiting fee was applied, and GPS shows the driver never entered the pickup radius — so NS-1/NS-2/NS-6 are not triggered and no account flag is warranted.
